title: Laryngeal inlet
summary: The laryngeal inlet (laryngeal aditus, laryngeal aperture) is the opening that connects the pharynx and the larynx.

sections.heading: Borders
paragraphs: the free curved edge of the epiglottis, anteriorly the arytenoid cartilages, the corniculate cartilages, and the interarytenoid fold, posteriorly the aryepiglottic fold, laterally
